features.constraint: Warm brown skin; East Asian features; gentle closed-mouth smile in neutral poses.
features.name: face and skin

features.constraint: Large teal eyes with the canon iris/highlight structure. In the side profile view: ONE eye only, gaze along the direction of travel, never at the viewer.
features.name: teal eyes

features.constraint: Dark-brown twin tails, one on each side, each tied with a teal scrunchie. In profile both tails are arranged behind the shoulder/back line and BOTH scrunchies stay visible; the tails are separate parts so they can lag and settle behind a stride.
features.name: twin tails

features.constraint: Two small black hair clips seated ON the hair mass (never floating, never detached in space).
features.name: hair clips

features.constraint: Navy high-collar jacket with teal trim lines, front buttons, and a small star pin on the chest. In profile: collar and placket read edge-on, the neck is seated INTO the collar (no notch, no perch gap), one strap line runs over the shoulder to the waist.
features.name: navy jacket

features.constraint: A backpack worn behind the torso. In profile it is a rounded side mass with volume (never a flat rectangle slab) and its strap crosses the shoulder.
features.name: backpack

features.constraint: Three glass capsule jars hang at the waist from the straps, each holding a tiny creature. In profile they recede: the near jar full, the other two overlapping and partial; no jar is ever hidden behind an arm.
features.name: three waist capsule jars

features.constraint: Pleated teal skirt. In profile the pleats wrap to a side silhouette (never the symmetric front skirt); the hem can sway a few pixels with a stride.
features.name: pleated teal skirt

features.constraint: Teal tights on both legs. In profile the far leg carries the far-side treatment (slightly darker, marginally smaller/higher) so crossings read clearly.
features.name: teal tights

features.constraint: Navy-and-teal sneakers with the canon stripe layout and pale sole. The profile shoe is DRAWN long - toe forward, heel back - never a front shoe stretched, and never a front shoe head-on.
features.name: sneakers

features.constraint: Both arms exist in every view (near and far, the far arm offset and slightly darker in profile), sleeves matching the jacket, skin-tone hands. In a walk they swing in opposition to the legs.
features.name: arms and hands

provenance: Copied from Mochiko's canon design record (human cast, Mars rules: East Asian, warm brown skin, dark-brown twin tails, teal eyes, navy jacket with teal trim) and her canon art of record, public/assets/show-canon/humans/mochiko-v2.png (1536x1024, measured from main by the parity lane, SMOKE-TESTS.md 2026-10-28). The hair-fixed texture (mochiko-fixed.png, PR #470) is the current version of that art for rig work. When this example is used for a real run, re-derive every feature from the canon record at that time - this file is an example of the shape, not a substitute for the record.
